title: Things I built. Things I actually care about.

items.title: SprintDesk
items.description: Agile sprint tracking is core to how software teams work. I built an interactive tool for it from the ground up, with a Kanban board, real-time sync, and MCP integrations connecting GitHub, Jira, Slack, and Google Calendar into one workspace.

items.title: Cue
items.description: Built by a singer who kept running into a coordination problem with no good software solution. Started with user interviews. Designed in Figma. Ended with role-based real-time views for singers, musicians, and managers, each seeing exactly what they need.

items.title: AI and the future of education
items.description: A thematic analysis of 800+ YouTube comments. Not really about AI, about what people believe learning is for, and what that reveals about trust, identity, and who education was ever designed for.
